description: Voids a prediction with a reason, only on a day strictly BEFORE the prediction's `date` (once its date has begun it can no longer be voided: it will be scored whatever the caller now thinks). The prediction stays in the ledger with the reason and is never scored; get_prediction_stats counts voided predictions separately, so voiding cannot hide one. A scored prediction cannot be voided. Voiding twice changes nothing and returns the first void (alreadyVoided: true). Local file only (predictions.json): never contacts Suunto, needs no credentials. Output: { id, voided: { at, reason }, alreadyVoided }. Not read-only; annotated destructive because a void cannot be undone (nothing is removed from the file, but the prediction is out of the scoring for good); idempotent.
name: void_prediction
title: Void a prediction before its date (kept, with the reason; cannot be undone)
